notes: The ASV's that it may be handled leaves בַּכָּף wholly unrendered; the preposition, its assimilated article and the noun are each their own unrepresented unit rather than being folded into the verb.

Partition verified. *handled* is the rendering of תָּפַשׂ, not a fusion carrying כַּף's sense as well, so rule 30 does not reach it. The object suffix of אֹתָהּ correctly takes the promoted subject pronoun under the passive recasting (rule 40), while both object markers are unrepresented (rule 16).
